explanation: This is the lesson’s compact reference example for Workbook Documentation and Auditability. Confirm its assumptions, target feature/version, and expected result; it is an example rather than a universal answer for every workbook. Returns a readable fallback when the calculation raises an error; it does not distinguish every possible cause, so investigate unexpected errors rather than hiding them.
review_checklist: Confirm that the named cells, tables, sheets or APIs exist in the local example.
Compare the actual result with an independent expectation and check a relevant edge case.
For workbooks/macros/scripts, test on a copy and document supported versions, trust boundaries and limitations.
